items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah. She was very nice to me.

ctx.x: Doris Duke. So it might have been her.
Yeah. She was very nice to me. I just thought of it now. Could it? Who would have money like that that I would know?
It’s a possibility, because she came into the club, and people who came into the club were aware of the accident and what happened. So it could have been her.
